cases.prompt: A Literature workflow has an approved reader-owned proposition with origin paths. Record it.
cases.expected_output: Routes to the Record an Evergreen candidate action, requires proposition, reason, origin kind and origin paths, and does not reinterpret the proposition.

cases.prompt: A specialist has assembled a complete note draft. Publish the artifact.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Publish an artifact, runs /write-checks before any write, and uses the CLI only for the transaction.

cases.prompt: Record a link between two notes, then inspect source analysis.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Record a link and Inspect source analysis; exact CLI flags are obtained from the relevant reference rather than repeated in each action.
